name: print-social-white-swoosh-crop-cafe-payment-tap-photo
title: Cafe Tap Payment Photo in a White Swoosh
whatItIs: A photograph of a smiling barista offering a phone showing a payment screen while a hand taps a blue card, cropped inside a large white curved swoosh with a logo pill at top right.
whatItMeans: The curved white crop frames the tap moment like a lens, and the warm cafe scene humanises payment.
techniques: Photo cropped by a large curved white shape
Two devices meeting in the centre of the frame
Brand blue in the card and the barista's clothing

vocabulary.definition: A photo masked by a large curved shape.
The instant a card meets a payment device.
Soft out-of-focus lights behind a subject.
